ownerStatement: Asked by repeat98 in chat 23 Oct 2026: make POLY8 stable, optimize it and bring it live again for the card and USB approaches.
reason: 0.3.1 bounds POLY8's own time with a frame-timer voice governor and runs its render through cached memory, pushing every line it touched before the audio interrupt ends; the OT pages and controls are unchanged, so the 0.2.7 captures are retained. Measured on the owner's MKII with RAM-booted development twins of the current beta base (cached and uncached module code): no freeze or frame stall under eight held keys, chords over the sequencer and rapid presses, where 0.3.0 froze; audio from PLAY matches 0.3.0 to the recorder floor, including after replacing 0.3.0 with the published package. Waived for this exact source: the card build and the exact tester image on a unit, Part/project reload and power cycles, chip worst-case cycles and complete memory bounds.
